title: USDA Departmental Regulation Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting universally useful metadata and key policy details from a USDA Departmental Regulation document.

document_type.description: Type of document, such as Departmental Regulation.

issuing_location.description: Location of the issuing organization as stated in the document header.

subject.description: Subject or title of the document.

issue_date.description: Date the document was issued or dated, as written in the document.

expiration_date.description: Expiration date of the document, as written in the document.

opi.description: Office of Primary Interest (OPI) or equivalent responsible office listed in the document.

supersedes.description: Information about any prior document this document supersedes.

document_title.description: Title or subject of the superseded document.

document_date.description: Date of the superseded document, as written in the document.

scope.description: Statement describing to whom or what the document applies.

purpose.description: High-level purpose statement of the document.

inquiries.description: Contact information for questions or inquiries about the document.

office.description: Office or division to which inquiries should be directed.

table_of_contents.description: Top-level table of contents entries listed in the document.

section_title.description: Title of the section or appendix.

page.description: Page number listed in the table of contents.

major_it_investment_definition.description: Definition and criteria describing when an investment is considered a major IT investment.

summary.description: Concise summary of the document's definition of a major IT investment.

omb_criteria.description: Criteria attributed to OMB for defining a major IT investment.

usda_cpic_criteria.description: Criteria attributed to the USDA CPIC process for classifying an IT investment as major.

critical_investment_attributes.description: Attributes listed as examples of investments identified as critical.

items.description: One attribute of a critical investment.

policy_actors.description: Actors explicitly named in the policy text as having responsibility, authority, decision-making, definitional, oversight, contact, or other operative roles.

items.description: One named policy actor as written in the document.

policy_obligations.description: Policy statements that describe rules, classifications, determinations, responsibilities, or actions established by the document.

items.description: One obligation, rule, or operative policy statement summarized or quoted from the document.

obligation_conditions.description: Conditions, criteria, thresholds, or triggering circumstances under which a policy obligation, determination, or classification applies.

items.description: One condition or criterion associated with a policy obligation.

actor_roles.description: Roles played by named policy actors in relation to the document's rules, such as defining criteria, identifying critical investments, applying the policy, or handling inquiries.

role.description: Role or function the actor performs in the policy.

details.description: Optional supporting detail about how the actor's role is described in the document.

policy_statements.description: Structured policy statements extracted from the document, preserving hierarchy and separating statement function from normative force.

statement_id.description: Unique identifier for the statement within the extracted document, such as '4', '4a', or '4b(1)'.

parent_statement_id.description: Identifier of the parent statement when this statement is nested under another statement.

text.description: The statement text as written or closely paraphrased from the document.

statement_function.description: Functional role of the statement in the document, such as definition, obligation, condition, scope, exception, authority, inquiry, classification_rule, responsibility, or reference.

normative_force.description: Normative force of the statement, kept separate from statement function.

actor.description: Actor associated with the statement, if one is explicitly identified.

target.description: Person, organization, system, investment, or subject to which the statement applies, if identifiable.

conditions.description: Conditions, thresholds, or triggering circumstances that qualify the statement.

items.description: One condition associated with the statement.

classification_result.description: Resulting classification, determination, or status produced by the statement, if applicable.

consequences.description: Consequences, follow-on effects, or outcomes stated or implied by the policy statement.

items.description: One consequence or outcome associated with the statement.

citation.description: Section or paragraph citation for the statement, if available.

acronyms.description: Acronyms and abbreviations defined in the document.

definition.description: Meaning of the acronym or abbreviation.

authorities_and_references.description: Authorities and references cited in the document.

items.description: One authority or reference citation as written in the document.
